mapper.sql: CASE r.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'HELD' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN 'CHECKED_IN' THEN 'CHECKED_IN' WHEN 'CHECKED_OUT' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 'RELEASED' WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN 'NO_SHOW' THEN 'RELEASED' END
mapper.select: INSERT INTO reconcile_run (tenant_id, hotel_id, window_from, window_to, trigger_source, triggered_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{from}::date, #{to}::date, #{triggerSource}, #{triggeredBy}) RETURNING run_id
mapper.update: UPDATE reconcile_run SET status = 'COMPLETED', findings_new = #{newFindings}, findings_repeated = #{repeatedFindings}, findings_repaired = #{repairedFindings}, findings_superseded = #{supersededFindings}, findings_open = #{openFindings}, finished_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId}

UPDATE reconcile_run SET status = 'FAILED', error = '批次超时未结束（进程可能已崩溃），由下一轮回收', finished_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < now() - make_interval(secs => #{olderThanSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, hotel_id, window_from, window_to, trigger_source, status, findings_new, findings_repeated, findings_repaired, findings_superseded, findings_open, started_at, finished_at, error FROM reconcile_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND run_id = #{runId}

SELECT run_id, hotel_id, window_from, window_to, trigger_source, status, findings_new, findings_repeated, findings_repaired, findings_superseded, findings_open, started_at, finished_at, error FROM reconcile_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO reconcile_finding (tenant_id, hotel_id, kind, severity, target_key, stay_date, room_id, reservation_id, detail, first_run_id, last_run_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{f.kind}, #{severity}, #{f.targetKey}, #{f.stayDate}, #{f.roomId}, #{f.reservationId}, #{f.detail}, #{runId}, #{runId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, hotel_id, kind, target_key) WHERE status = 'OPEN' DO UPDATE SET occurrences = reconcile_finding.occurrences + 1, last_seen_at = now(), last_run_id = EXCLUDED.last_run_id, detail = EXCLUDED.detail, stay_date = EXCLUDED.stay_date, room_id = EXCLUDED.room_id, reservation_id = EXCLUDED.reservation_id RETURNING finding_id, occurrences
mapper.sql: finding_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, kind, severity, target_key, detail, status, occurrences, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, repaired_at, settled_at, settled_by, settle_reason, stay_date, room_id, reservation_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO reconcile_watermark (tenant_id, hotel_id, scanned_through) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{scannedThrough}::date) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, hotel_id) DO UPDATE SET scanned_through = GREATEST(reconcile_watermark.scanned_through, EXCLUDED.scanned_through), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS occupancy_id, o.reservation_id, o.room_id, lower(o.stay_range) AS stay_date, r.status AS reservation_status, o.status AS occupancy_status, AS expected_occupancy_status FROM room_occupancy o JOIN reservation r ON r.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND r.hotel_id = o.hotel_id AND r.id = o.reservation_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{w.tenantId} AND o.hotel_id = #{w.hotelId} AND o.kind = 'RESERVATION' AND o.stay_range && daterange(#{w.from}::date, #{w.to}::date, '[)') AND o.status NOT IN ('SUPERSEDED') AND o.status <>

SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, GREATEST(min(lower(l.planned_range)), #{w.from}::date) AS stay_date, r.status AS reservation_status FROM reservation r JOIN reservation_line l ON l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND l.hotel_id = r.hotel_id AND l.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{w.tenantId} AND r.hotel_id = #{w.hotelId} AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') AND l.planned_range && daterange(#{w.from}::date, #{w.to}::date, '[)') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_occupancy o WHERE o.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND o.hotel_id = r.hotel_id AND o.reservation_id = r.id AND o.kind = 'RESERVATION' AND o.status IN ('HELD', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') ) GROUP BY r.id, r.status
SELECT tenant_id, id AS hotel_id FROM hotel WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY tenant_id, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(*)::int AS pending, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - min(e.occurred_at)))::bigint, 0) AS oldest_seconds FROM outbox_event e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (e.hotel_id = #{hotelId} OR e.hotel_id IS NULL) AND e.published_at IS NULL AND e.occurred_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => #{olderThanSeconds})

SELECT count(*)::int AS pending, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - min(i.received_at)))::bigint, 0) AS oldest_seconds FROM inbox_event i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (i.hotel_id = #{hotelId} OR i.hotel_id IS NULL) AND i.outcome = 'PARKED_GAP' AND i.received_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => #{olderThanSeconds})
